The quotation is about directing education funding to where it's needed most — a funding allocation policy for schools. The specific mechanism is targeted/needs-based education funding distribution, which falls squarely under I2 (Education and Research Institutions). There's a secondary public finance dimension (H5 — National Government Expenditures) given the explicit focus on driving funding, but the substance is education policy.
